# Reviewed files the launcher's dependencies carry beyond their own code
# (#176), checked by tools/licencereview in the GitLab `deps` job, after
# go-licenses has checked each package's declared licence.
#
# A declared licence covers the package's own code. What it does not
# cover -- files embedded into the binary, code under a third_party or
# vendor directory or its own licence file, generated tables, and code a
# comment says came from elsewhere -- has no licence field, so each such
# file in a package linked into the shipped binary (linux/amd64 and
# linux/arm64) must sit under one of these entries.
#
# Format: "<module>@<version> <path> <kind> <licence or finding>". <path>
# is a file, a directory prefix ending in "/", or "./" for the whole
# module. Exact @version: a bump stops the entry matching, and the files
# are read again. An entry matching nothing fails as stale -- delete it,
# or re-review it for the new version. Licence decisions are the owner's.
#
# List every finding, reviewed or not: go run ./tools/licencereview -list

charm.land/lipgloss/v2@v2.0.6 terminal.go notice BSD-3-Clause
# queryBackgroundColor is "copied from x/term@v0.1.3": golang.org/x/term,
# the Go Authors' BSD-3-Clause, already allowed.

github.com/charmbracelet/ultraviolet@v0.0.0-20260811164956-006e29f97886 key_table.go notice MIT
# SS3 keypad map "taken from Foot keymap.h and XTerm modifyOtherKeys":
# a table of escape-sequence names (Foot is MIT; XTerm's is the X11
# licence, MIT-style). Interface facts, not expression.

github.com/charmbracelet/x/ansi@v0.11.8 color.go notice ISC
# The nearest-256-colour conversion is "mostly ported from
# tmux/colour.c". tmux is ISC, already allowed; ISC asks for its notice
# to be kept with copies.

github.com/lucasb-eyer/go-colorful@v1.4.1 hsluv.go notice MIT
# From github.com/hsluv/hsluv-go, "Under MIT License", already allowed.

github.com/clipperhouse/displaywidth@v0.11.0 trie.go generated Unicode-3.0
github.com/mattn/go-runewidth@v0.0.24 runewidth_table.go generated Unicode-3.0
github.com/rivo/uniseg@v0.4.7 ./ generated Unicode-3.0
# Character-width and segmentation tables generated from the Unicode
# Character Database (EastAsianWidth.txt, emoji-data.txt and the
# segmentation property files; uniseg's headers point at
# https://www.unicode.org/license.html). Unicode-3.0 is permissive but
# not on go-licenses' allowed list, and asks for its notice to ship with
# copies of the data.

golang.org/x/sys@v0.48.0 unix/dev_linux.go notice BSD-3-Clause+glibc-sysmacros-formula
# Mkdev/Major/Minor "extracted and adapted from bits/sysmacros.h in the
# glibc sources" (glibc is LGPL-2.1-or-later): the dev_t bit layout,
# re-expressed as three Go shift-and-mask functions by the Go Authors.

golang.org/x/sys@v0.48.0 unix/ generated BSD-3-Clause+Linux-UAPI-constants
# zerrors_*, zsyscall_*, zsysnum_*, ztypes_*, zptrace_*: constants,
# syscall numbers and struct layouts generated from the Linux UAPI
# headers, which carry GPL-2.0 WITH Linux-syscall-note -- the note that
# exists so programs can use the kernel's interface without the GPL.
